label: CanadaBuys
terms_note: robots.txt is Disallow: / for every agent → no public fetching; the site publishes tender open-data CSVs (not fetched this pass) — until that URL is verified the user's session reads the notices.
reason: Remaining gaps: (1) CSV detection for bodies not typed text/csv — the only machine-readable access is the CSV downloads of open.canada.ca dataset 6abd20d4-7a1c-4b38-baa2-9525d0bb2fd2 (https://canadabuys.canada.ca/opendata/pub/openTenderNotice-ouvertAvisAppelOffres.csv, newTenderNotice-nouvelAvisAppelOffres.csv), and re-checked 2026-09-25 they are served as 'content-type: application/octet-stream' from Azure Blob storage, while the runtime's new CSV parsing (2026-09-25 additions) triggers only on a text/csv content type (the TypeScript runtime has no override); (2) client-side filtering/truncation of rows — the open-notice file is 6.6 MB with 924 rows of 67 columns and no query, page or limit parameters, so search_postings would return the whole file on every call. There is no query API; bids go through CanadaBuys / SAP Ariba.
